name: Malfunctioning Engine
disable: DC 32 Arcana check (expert) or DC 32 Occultism check (expert) four times to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 30) to cleanse the vaultline's effect on the ecdysis engine. Closing the sluice in area B1 drains power from the engine and counts as one success, as does calibrating the control panel in area B23. For each success, reduce the hazard's number of actions by 1.
routine:
(4 actions) The warpline focuses on a random creature in the room, which must make a DC 36 Fortitude save save. A single creature can't be targeted more than once on the hazard's turn.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and gains a +1 status bonus to further saves vs. the hazard.
Success The creature is unaffected.
Failure The creature becomes Enfeebled 1 or Clumsy 1 (determined randomly), or its enfeebled or clumsy condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of 4 for each condition).
Critical Failure As failure, except the condition value becomes 2 or increases by 2.

items.name: Fleshwarp
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the ecdysis engine

---
Effect The warpline arcs throughout the area. Each creature in the room must attempt a DC 36 Reflex save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and gains a +1 status bonus to further saves against the hazard.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes Sickened 1.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Sickened 2.

text: The malfunctioning ecdysis engine warps the flesh of creatures that enter the room.
